scope.summary: Enforce cloud projection, consent, and authority boundaries for cloud lanes.
forbidden_paths: raw workspace cloud upload without ProjectionPlan
cloud output becoming authoritative without promotion
npm/JavaScript proof targets for this WP
app/src-tauri launch or IPC authority for this WP
proof commands that pass with zero matching tests
acceptance_criteria: Cloud lane launch fails closed without required ProjectionPlan/ConsentReceipt.
Cloud lane messages carry redaction/projection metadata.
Cloud outputs are advisory until explicit promotion.

Cloud lane launch MUST reject missing, expired, mismatched, or revoked ConsentReceipts; receipts MUST bind to ProjectionPlan hash, run_id, lane_id, model_session_id, provider, scope, retention, and fan-out targets. Revocation MUST cancel pending covered jobs and mark affected lanes blocked/cancelled with CX-MM-007 plus typed consent_status metadata.
Cloud projection and consent records include stable ids, hashes, source artifact refs, redaction policy, retention/export posture, provider profile, fan-out disclosure, and replay-safe summaries.
Cloud lane denied/missing consent paths emit CX-MM-007 plus Flight Recorder/EventLedger evidence and do not launch provider calls or create partial authority state.
Cloud tool/sampling requests follow explicit consent/control and result-visibility boundaries; provider tool descriptions are not trusted as authority.
Cloud consent/projection proof MUST cover missing, expired, mismatched, and revoked consent receipts, and must cancel or block pending covered jobs with typed durable status.
ProjectionPlan and ConsentReceipt rows MUST link to run_id, lane_id, model_session_id, provider_kind, scope hash, payload/artifact refs, EventLedger event id, and UserManual behavior id.

After implementation and before READY_FOR_VALIDATION, this MT MUST receive post-implementation adversarial review against the actual diff. Findings must be fixed or converted into explicit lifecycle blocker/missing_resource/proof_status state; the implementer may not self-certify COMPLETED.
scope.risk_if_missed: Cloud models can silently receive or author workspace state outside Handshake policy.

implementation_notes: Cloud lane launch must fail closed with CX-MM-007 when required ProjectionPlan or ConsentReceipt is missing.
Consent receipt, cloud escalation request, and projection-plan evidence must preserve stable ids, hashes, manifest refs, retention, and replay/export semantics from the folded cloud-consent stub.
Cloud lane messages must carry projection/redaction metadata and may not become authoritative until explicitly promoted.
Provider-specific consent UI flows are out of scope; shared backend artifact/manifest semantics are in scope.
Flight Recorder/EventLedger events must link cloud request, consent/projection artifact refs, lane_id, run_id, session/model_session_id, and outcome.
MCP consent/tool-safety guidance translates to Handshake capability check -> consent/projection -> Flight Recorder/EventLedger -> execution -> result capture.
Cloud outputs are advisory artifacts until a typed promotion record exists, even if the provider response is structured or high confidence.
Do not store raw secrets, unredacted workspace data, or full cloud prompts in Flight Recorder payloads; store manifest/artifact refs and redacted summaries.
Use Flight Recorder/EventLedger payloads as bounded events plus artifact refs; do not put unbounded model output, raw secrets, or prompt-only state in event payloads.

If this MT changes any product behavior, storage/event contract, command, IPC/API path, diagnostic surface, model lane, or navigation path, update the in-product UserManual in the same implementation change per HBR-MAN-004.

Product implementation for this MT must be Rust-only: Rust backend plus Rust native egui/Argus surfaces where UI is touched. Legacy app/src, app/src-tauri, React, Tauri/WebView, TypeScript, JavaScript, docs/model-manual, and npm proof targets are reference-only or forbidden and MUST NOT satisfy implementation/proof authority.

Proof commands must name exact Rust test targets or exact test names. Zero matching tests is a hard failure. Deterministic provider fakes are allowed for cloud/local model calls, but PostgreSQL/EventLedger/ArtifactStore/CRDT/UserManual/Argus authority must touch real Handshake-owned Rust resources or an explicit real PostgreSQL URL.
Each behavior-changing MT must include same-change UserManual coverage for the changed behavior; MT-011 audits coverage and cannot substitute for same-change HBR-MAN-004 proof.

This pre-implementation contract review does not replace post-implementation review. After coding, run adversarial review against the actual diff through the listed lenses and update MT status signaling before handoff.

v5_remediation_2026_08_04.validator_judgment: Cloud lane projection and consent receipts lack the active HBR-PRIV resource-bound scope, cross-account isolation, revocation/context-switch, and scoped diagnostic evidence required for approval.
v5_remediation_2026_08_04.remediation_by: KERNEL_BUILDER-20260801-214802 (delegated; reviewed and blast-radius-verified by KERNEL_BUILDER)
v5_remediation_2026_08_04.operator_authorization: Operator explicitly accepted this scope expansion on 2026-08-04 after KERNEL_BUILDER surfaced the self-minted-approver defect.

core_defect_fixed.was: operator_chat.rs minted the consent receipt approver itself: approved_by_ref = format!("operator://{}/cloud-selection", selection.owner_session), beside approved:true and ~365 days validity. owner_session is a governance ROLE LABEL (e.g. swarm_coordinator / KERNEL_BUILDER), identical for every operator on every machine and dangling after restart. The column (migration 0341) is plain TEXT with no CHECK and no FK. A self-issued, year-long approval on the path that authorizes sending operator data to a third-party cloud provider therefore proved NOTHING about who consented.
core_defect_fixed.now: NewModelLaneCloudConsentReceipt.approver is a REQUIRED typed AccountBoundAuthority (Account{owner_account_id, actor_principal_id, authenticated_session, access_space, workspace} | Unattributed{reason}) derived from store.access(), i.e. server-derived and never payload-asserted. It delegates its decision to the SAME ResourceScopeQuery::authorize_row the storage read boundary uses, so there is no second matching rule to drift. from_access() means a read-only or system context structurally cannot mint an account-bound approval.

v5_remediation_2026_08_04.legacy_approver_decision: Split narrowly rather than all-or-nothing. RETAINED for provenance but demoted out of authority - real receipts carry human-meaningful refs (ticket ids, UI action refs), so deleting the column would destroy real lineage and pretend the self-issued receipts never existed; it is made honest by being read by NOTHING. REJECTED at write time only for the self-issuance SHAPE (issuer == subject: exactly operator://{owner_session}/...). A blanket operator:// ban was rejected as theatre - it would refuse honest refs while a caller self-issues under any other scheme.
v5_remediation_2026_08_04.validity_decision: 365 days -> OPERATOR_CHAT_CLOUD_CONSENT_VALIDITY_HOURS = 12. Reasoning: the receipt authorizes ONE lane in ONE run; a lane cannot outlive its run, a run cannot outlive the coordinator, neither survives a restart. A capability outliving its subject by three orders of magnitude is a dangling capability, and every idempotent re-launch on the same run/lane ids re-uses it instead of asking again. Run-scoped consent (migration 0353) is a SCOPE mechanism, not an EXPIRY one, and no run-end timestamp exists at mint time - so a bounded window is the honest construction: longer than any working session, shorter than a day, cannot survive to the next working day. Revocation remains the kill switch; expiry is the backstop for when nobody revokes.
additional_defects_found_and_fixed: A REVOKED receipt still read approved:true while status:revoked - a durable record simultaneously claiming both states. Now set false on revocation.

The revoked path emitted 'ConsentReceipt is not approved', which made the 'ConsentReceipt is revoked' error the in-product UserManual documents UNREACHABLE. Checks reordered; both orderings fail closed, only one is honest.
SIDE EFFECT: broadcast_revoke_fences_factory_inflight_before_durable_lane_insert - recorded in this MT validation_v5 as a KNOWN FAILING MT-017 error-code ordering race - now PASSES.
v5_remediation_2026_08_04.hbr_priv_007_delegation: NewModelLaneCloudProjectionPlan.export_delegation = CloudExportDelegation{audience_refs, source_scope, authorization_receipt_ref}. validate_cloud_export_delegation requires audience to be a SUBSET of fan_out_targets (non-widening); validate_cloud_authority_pair requires the plan source_scope and the receipt approver to name the same account and refuses a plan paired with a receipt other than the one it names.
v5_remediation_2026_08_04.scope_columns_now_populated: Both cloud INSERTs stamp the five 0363/0364 scope columns. Previously the migration existed but NOTHING populated it for these tables - the columns were dead.
v5_remediation_2026_08_04.falsifiability: TEN inversions, each applied, run against real managed PostgreSQL, OBSERVED, and restored. Observed failures include: cross-account read (alice must not see the other account cloud projection plans / left: 0 / right: 1); cross-account REUSE (ProjectionPlan ... is not durable); forged owner on write (export_delegation.source_scope names an owning account this store is not authorized to write as); layer-2 with the SQL predicate removed (OwnerMismatch{requested,stored}); revoked relaunch (ConsentReceipt is revoked); audience widening (must not widen beyond fan_out_targets); and self-issued approver (approved_by_ref operator://KERNEL_BUILDER-selfissue/cloud-selection is self-issued: its identity component is this row own owner_session governance role label, which authorizes nothing).
v5_remediation_2026_08_04.stale_assertion_repaired: lib swarm_orchestration::operator_chat was 12 passed/1 failed. build_spawn_request_cli_sets_provider_working_dir_and_contract demanded requested_execution_policy_ref == execution-policy://operator-chat/official-cli, a value existing NOWHERE in src/ except that assertion. VERIFIED PRE-EXISTING, not caused by the 2026-08-04 lanes: CLI_BRIDGE_REQUESTED_EXECUTION_POLICY_REF is byte-identical at HEAD 50517aec and in the working tree, and neither the literal nor the policy assignment appears in any uncommitted diff. The delegated agent and KERNEL_BUILDER had each initially mis-attributed it to a concurrent lane by reasoning from file overlap instead of the diff; that inference was wrong and is corrected here. The assertion was not merely stale but ACTIVELY WRONG - official_cli_bridge.rs rejects any requested ref that is not CLI_BRIDGE_REQUESTED_EXECUTION_POLICY_REF, so satisfying it would have BROKEN the operator-chat CLI lane. Repaired by asserting the CONSTANT instead of a literal so a future rename moves both sides together. 13 passed/0 failed after; executed test count did not decrease.
